title: 10-Second 3D Cartoon Story Generator
prompt: Create an original and captivating 10-second 3D cartoon story with a surprising beginning, exciting action, and a heartwarming or unexpected ending. Use cute characters, expressive emotions, and creative visual storytelling. Keep the story short, clear, and easy to turn into an animated video. Write only the story events in chronological order. Do not generate images or image prompts.
